title: UI Server Can Click
description: This is the one server that can drive the window, so it is developer-only.
body: This is the one server that writes. Everything else OpenKaava hosts is a read, deliberately, so that a leaked token costs knowledge and not control. A tool that clicks cannot be that, which is why this server is `dev_only`, starts switched off even once developer mode reveals it, and says so on the row that draws it.
